species: The enriched protein bands migrating at approximately 60 kDa were excised, digested with trypsin, and analyzed by electrospray ionization quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry analysis.
sample_source: S. denitrificans grown on 1.5 mM stigmasterol cells
S. denitrificans grown on 1.5 mM stigmasterol cells were resuspended in twice the volume of lysis buffer (20 mM Tris/HCl pH 7.5) and 0.1 mg DNAse.
strain: S. denitrificans Chol-1ST (DSMZ 13999) and T. aromatica K172 (DSMZ 6984) were obtained from the Deutsche Sammlung für Mikroorganismen und Zellkulturen.
